title: 第2章 盗天符

content_zh:
嘶，很疼！
不是在做梦！
这就意味着，他农民翻身把歌唱的机会来了。
“不过这盗天符……盗点什么好呢？”
“任何事物都能盗取，那我要一座银行，也能给我弄来？”
宁小凡坐着床上冥思苦想，“呃，还是算了，真要弄来一座银行，我估计会被国际刑警追杀到死。”
“要不，把大明星‘渔冰卿’给弄过来……”
他脑袋又跳出一个邪恶的念头。
渔冰卿。
全亚洲第一女明星，一张颠倒众生的绝色脸蛋，不知让多少权贵富豪拜倒在她的石榴裙下，影响力甚至辐射全球。
若能和女神在一起，就算折寿二十年，估计也会有成千上万的男人争得头破血流吧。
“不行！我这么道德高尚，诚实守法的人，怎么能干这种龌龊的事情？”
宁小凡甩了甩脑袋，干脆把盗天符往兜里一揣，以后再说吧。
翌日清晨。
教室外的走廊上。
“锦瑟无端五十弦，一弦一柱思华年。庄生晓梦迷蝴蝶，望帝春心托杜鹃……”
“好美的诗啊，这些诗人，真是才华横溢。”
楚惜颜捧着语文课本，美眸闪烁着异彩。
作为一个文艺女青年，她平时最喜欢朗诵诗歌，从李白、杜甫到歌德、普希金、莎士比亚，她基本通读了个遍。
“什么时候，我也能写出这种诗就好了。”少女靠在栏杆上，微微叹气。

她穿着一身白色雪纺裙，肌肤白皙如玉，眸如两点黑漆，长发束成清纯的马尾，美得像是一幅江南水墨画卷。
宁小凡刚上楼，直接看呆了，连手里拎着的早饭都忘了吃。
“好美。”
楚惜颜是二班的学委，也是清江一中两大校花之一，数千男生做梦都想得之青睐的女神。
“不愧是楚大校花，太漂亮了，以后哪个男的娶了她，绝对烧了八辈子高香！”
宁小凡拿起手里的烧饼狠狠啃了一口。
“臭死了！”
突然，教室里传来一道厌恶的咆哮，顾天宇气势汹汹地冲出来，指着宁小凡怒骂道：
“宁小凡！你吃的是什么垃圾，臭气熏天的，还不赶快给我扔了！”
“烧饼豆浆你都没吃过？”
宁小凡又咬了一口，有滋有味的嚼着，明明这么香，哪里臭了？
“哼，穷逼！”
顾天宇不屑地瞥了他一眼，抖了抖衣领：“知道本少爷早餐吃的什么吗？告诉你吧，黑松露配鹅肝，一盘价值2000RMB，都抵你几个月生活费了吧？”
“傻叉，肝是生物的排毒器官，吃多了容易中毒，悠着点吧你。”
说完，宁小凡懒得再看他一眼，径直走进教室。
“这家伙，说话还真逗。”一旁的楚惜颜嫣然浅笑。
“哼，穷鬼就是穷鬼！”
顾天宇冷冷一笑，觉得宁小凡不过是强行狡辩。
他可是标准的高富帅一枚，无论是家世还是成绩，都是同龄佼佼者，宁小凡这穷瘪货，跟他比差天上去了都。
教室最后一排，宁小凡捧着本英语书，看着看着就打起了瞌睡。

“咋了，凡哥，精神不太好啊？”
前桌一个戴着黑框眼镜，模样有点猥琐的男生转过来，猛的一下子把他拍醒了。
他叫盛辉，是宁小凡在班里为数不多的朋友之一。
“还说呢，昨晚王者荣耀十八连跪，全是坑，我都掉到青铜了！”宁小凡一提这个就来气。
“哈哈，活该！”盛辉大笑，“叫你不和我双排。”
“滚粗，你丫比我还坑！”
宁小凡没好气骂道。
上午第四节。
班主任刘蓉的语文课。
随着一道体态臃肿的身影走入教室，叽叽喳喳的声音停了下来。
“把课本翻开，今天我们复习胡润东的《江南夜》，这首诗几个重点，一模可能会考……”
刘蓉板着一张脸，就跟谁欠她几百万似的。
上了一会儿课后，刘蓉似乎想调节一下紧张的气氛，便道：
“诗歌，是文学宝库中的瑰宝，是语言的精华，智慧的结晶，大家平时有没有写诗的爱好？”
全班同学都撇了撇嘴，他们整天刷题背单词，谁会去写诗啊。
“课代表？”
刘蓉微笑地看向楚惜颜，楚惜颜是学委兼语文课代表，在班里语文成绩最好。
“不好意思，刘老师，我没试过……”
楚惜颜歉意道，她虽然很仰慕那些诗人，但自己并没有这个基因。
“嗯，没事。”

刘蓉点点头，目光一扫，忽然发现宁小凡正在呼呼大睡，气得她当场猛拍讲台。

content_en:
Hiss, it hurts!
Not dreaming!
This means that he, a farmer, has the opportunity to stand up and sing.
"But this sky-stealing talisman... what should I steal?"
"Anything can be stolen, so if I want a bank, can you get it for me?"
Ning Xiaofan sat on the bed and thought hard, "Well, let's forget it. If I really get a bank, I will probably be chased to death by Interpol."
"How about bringing the big star 'Yu Bingqing' here..."
Another evil thought popped into his head.
Yu Bingqing.
The number one female star in Asia, with a stunning face that captivates all living beings, has made countless rich and powerful people bow to her, and her influence even radiates around the world.
If you can be with the goddess, even if your life is shortened by twenty years, thousands of men will probably fight with each other to death.
"No! How can I, a person with high moral standards, honest and law-abiding people, do such a dirty thing?"
Ning Xiaofan shook his head and simply put the Heaven Stealing Talisman in his pocket and let's talk about it later.
The next morning.
In the corridor outside the classroom.
"There are fifty strings of brocade strings for no reason, each string and one column reminds me of my good years. Zhuang Sheng dreamed of butterflies at dawn, and looked forward to the emperor's spring heart with cuckoos..."
"What a beautiful poem. These poets are really talented."
Chu Xiyan held the Chinese textbook, her beautiful eyes sparkling.
As a literary young woman, she usually likes to recite poetry most. From Li Bai and Du Fu to Goethe, Pushkin, and Shakespeare, she has basically read them all.
"Whenever, I wish I could write this kind of poem." The girl leaned on the railing and sighed slightly.
She was wearing a white chiffon skirt, her skin was as fair as jade, her eyes were as black as two points of paint, her long hair was tied into a pure ponytail, and she was as beautiful as a Jiangnan ink painting.
Ning Xiaofan had just gone upstairs and was so stunned that he even forgot to eat the breakfast he was carrying.
"So beautiful."
Chu Xiyan is the academic committee member of Class 2 and one of the two major beauties of Qingjiang No. 1 Middle School. She is a goddess that thousands of boys dream of being favored by.
"As expected of the campus beauty of Chu University, she is so beautiful. Any man who marries her in the future will definitely be in love with her for eight lifetimes!"
Ning Xiaofan picked up the sesame seed cake in his hand and took a bite.
"It stinks!"
Suddenly, a disgusted roar came from the classroom. Gu Tianyu rushed out angrily, pointed at Ning Xiaofan and cursed:
"Ning Xiaofan! What kind of garbage are you eating? It stinks to heaven. Why don't you throw it away quickly?"
"Have you never tasted sesame cakes and soy milk?"
Ning Xiaofan took another bite and chewed it deliciously. It smelled so good, but why did it stink?
"Huh, poor guy!"
Gu Tianyu glanced at him disdainfully and shook his collar: "Do you know what I had for breakfast? Let me tell you, black truffles and foie gras. A plate is worth 2,000 RMB, which is enough for your living expenses for several months, right?"
"Sicha, the liver is the detoxification organ of living things. If you eat too much, you can easily get poisoned. Please take it easy."
After saying that, Ning Xiaofan didn't bother to look at him again and walked straight into the classroom.
"This guy is really funny when he talks." Chu Xiyan on the side smiled sweetly.
"Humph, a poor man is a poor man!"
Gu Tianyu smiled coldly, feeling that Ning Xiaofan was just trying to make excuses.
He is a standard tall, rich and handsome person. He is one of the best of his age in terms of family background and achievements. Ning Xiaofan, a poor guy, is as bad as him.
In the last row of the classroom, Ning Xiaofan held an English book and dozed off while looking at it.
"What's wrong, Brother Fan, are you not feeling well?"
A boy at the front table wearing black-rimmed glasses and looking a little wretched turned around and slapped him awake.
His name is Sheng Hui, and he is one of Ning Xiaofan's few friends in the class.
"Also, last night King of Glory knelt down for eighteen consecutive times. They were all pitfalls. I even fell into bronze!" Ning Xiaofan got angry when he mentioned this.
"Haha, you deserve it!" Sheng Hui laughed, "I told you not to double queue with me."
"Fuck you, you are worse than me!"
Ning Xiaofan cursed angrily.
Fourth quarter in the morning.
Class teacher Liu Rong’s Chinese class.
As a bloated figure walked into the classroom, the chatter stopped.
"Open the textbook. Today we will review Hu Rundong's "Jiangnan Night". There are several key points in this poem that may be tested..."
Liu Rong had a straight face, as if someone owed her millions.
After attending class for a while, Liu Rong seemed to want to calm down the tense atmosphere and said:
“Poetry is a treasure in the treasure house of literature, the essence of language and the crystallization of wisdom. Do you have a hobby of writing poetry? "
The whole class curled their lips. They spent all day writing questions and memorizing words. Who would write poetry?
"Class representative? "
Liu Rong looked at Chu Xiyan with a smile. Chu Xiyan was the school committee member and Chinese class representative, and had the best Chinese scores in the class.
"Sorry, Teacher Liu, I haven't tried it..."
Chu Xiyan apologized and said that although she admired those poets, she did not have this gene.
"Well, it's okay. "
Liu Rong nodded, glanced around, and suddenly found Ning Xiaofan sleeping soundly. She was so angry that she slapped the podium on the spot.
